objective: Find a synthetic creator/content format capable of generating measurable organic attention, then attach monetization only after signal.

variants.archetype: Older Brazilian woman with sharp, warm observations about relationships, work and life
Fictional reflective character translating philosophy into everyday decisions
Fictional explainer delivering surprising useful facts with narrative hooks

phase_1.selection_rule: After comparable organic distribution, retain top variant on watch/completion plus saves/shares; kill variants with no meaningful signal.
phase_1.monetization_gate: Do not build paid media or a product around a character until distribution signal exists.
